author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
vibe coding is out, yap coding is in. 

now I have the Jira app on my phone, I can use voice input to create Jira tickets and assign it to the coding agent. 

talking to your laptop doesn't feel right, since there is a keyboard and typing is much faster.  but talking to your phone via Bluetooth feels so natural.
